title: Coco
why: Día de Muertos, 1–2 November — the one night the marigold bridge is open.
alt: The Book of Life (2014); the Lisbon earthquake, 1 November 1755

title: The Aviator
why: The Spruce Goose lifts off the water in Long Beach harbour for about a mile on 2 November 1947.
alt: All Souls' Day; Pasolini killed, 2 November 1975

title: V for Vendetta
why: Remember, remember, the fifth of November. Parliament goes up to the 1812 Overture.
alt: Back to the Future — Doc slips in the bathroom and invents the flux capacitor, 5 November 1955; Gunpowder, Treason & Plot

title: October: Ten Days That Shook the World
why: The storming of the Winter Palace on the night of 7 November 1917 (25 October, old style) — Eisenstein's version became the historical record.

title: Good Bye, Lenin!
why: The Wall opens on the night of 9 November 1989 while Alex's mother is in a coma — and the whole film is about hiding it from her.
alt: Kristallnacht, 9 November 1938; The Lives of Others

title: All Quiet on the Western Front
why: The armistice is signed for 11am on 11 November 1918, and the film sends its men over the top at 10:45.
alt: They Shall Not Grow Old; 1917; Joyeux Noël

title: Back to the Future
why: 10:04pm, Saturday 12 November 1955 — the Enchantment Under the Sea dance, and lightning strikes the clock tower.

title: Novembre
why: The five days after the Paris attacks of 13 November 2015, told as a manhunt.
alt: You Will Not Have My Hate (2022); Nova Scotia's Halifax explosion

title: We Were Soldiers
why: The 7th Cavalry lands at LZ X-Ray in the Ia Drang Valley on 14 November 1965 — the first big set-piece battle of the Vietnam War.

title: Judgment at Nuremberg
why: The Nuremberg trials open on 20 November 1945; Kramer's film takes the later judges' trial as its subject.

title: JFK
why: Dealey Plaza, 12:30pm, 22 November 1963 — the Zapruder frames, back and to the left.
alt: Parkland (2013); Jackie (2016); Shadowlands — C.S. Lewis died the same day

title: Ruby
why: Jack Ruby steps out of the crowd in the basement of Dallas police headquarters at 11:21am on 24 November 1963, live on NBC.
alt: Freddie Mercury died 24 November 1991 — Bohemian Rhapsody

title: The Last Waltz
why: The Band's farewell at Winterland on Thanksgiving night, 25 November 1976 — turkey dinner for 5,000, then Dylan.
alt: Rocky II — the rematch is fought on the same date, 25 November 1976

title: Hotel Mumbai
why: Ten gunmen come ashore in Mumbai on the evening of 26 November 2008; the film stays inside the Taj for the next three days.

title: Milk
why: Dan White shoots Harvey Milk and George Moscone in City Hall on the morning of 27 November 1978.
